objective: Exercise compiled organization formation and retained discovery supervision by implementing automatic deploy-only skill release announcements with a Terra builder and separate Astra reviewer.

authority.revision_effect: Corrected stale reviewer effort prose to high; no actor, scope or authority expansion.
authority.compatibility_correction: Root accepted the minimal same-scope fix for pre-existing empty-catalog-release rollback validation; rollback announcements remain manual.

reviewer.launch: Separate top-level app-server thread; host parent is collection ledger only, no runtime parent.

delivered_behavior: Verified successful deploy publishes the full commit, actually affected installed skills per target and reload guidance through the existing repository board API.
--no-announce opts out; pure same-current redeploy without link changes is suppressed; other commands do not auto-publish.
Exit 2 means the deployment succeeded while notification remains unconfirmed. The output supplies a message UUID to inspect before manual recovery; notification failure preserves the deployment.
One immediate publication attempt with the existing board CAS retries; truthful tool-invocation publisher identity; no outbox, replay command or exactly-once claim.

validation.coverage: Isolated real temporary-board roundtrip, kept-link content, additions/removals including emptied targets, uninstalled/ignored/excluded changes, executable modes, old/new exclusion effects, no-op/rollback target, opt-out/nonpublishing/failing commands, publication/ack uncertainty preserving state, canonical repository and released-symlink sibling resolution, repeated rollback into valid empty release and malformed/legacy rejection.

RA-001.classification: Pre-existing installation-target reconciliation omission exposed by new actual-visibility summary. First implementation would emit an incorrect no-reload summary for this existing boundary.
RA-001.evidence: Admission install_lists omits empty targets and admission plan iterates only the new manifest. Corrected reconciliation and two isolated regressions are preserved in subject-v2.

RA-002.classification: Pre-existing catalog/legacy-manifest compatibility mismatch, not a newly introduced validator restriction.
RA-002.evidence: Admission catalog install_lists can return {}, while admission rollback calls validate_manifest requiring nonempty targets. All-targets-empty reconciliation exercised this valid state and exposed inability to roll back into it.
RA-002.minimal_fix: Only catalog-derived rollback release records may pass an empty installation object; default legacy/malformed checks stay strict. Required so an exercised valid catalog release remains reachable through existing rollback.

limitations: Same-provider/different-model review; no cross-provider independence claim.
Mandatory board read exposed implementation-role/model metadata; no author-blind claim. No inherited discovery/design/builder conversation.
Reviewer inspected supervisor executable evidence and ran effect-free in-memory probes; it did not independently rerun effectful deployment tests.
